note:
The Dowson household on the 1891 return, schedule 36, '4 Clumber Road', from A. Hagues's full transcription, which replaces a first reading of the image that got the ages and birthplaces wrong. Benjamin (#2804), Alice (#2805), Bernard W. (#2807) and Alexander (#2808) were already in the record from 1901 at Felixstowe, Clumber Road West (#394), and are bound by number. Herbert Arthur, Hester Mary, Robert Manning, Felix and the four servants are new.

There are two pairs of twins: Robert Manning and Bernard William, 17, and Alexander and Felix, 13. That disagrees with the record's 1901 entry for Alexander (#2808), aged 27 and so born 1874, the twins' year; by this return he was born about 1878 and would have been 23 in 1901. The import fills blanks only and leaves #2808's birth year as it is, so the 1901 age wants checking against that return.

The record has no numbered house on Clumber Road, so the household is left unfiled under the address the return gives, with Felixstowe named so the unfiled page offers it. Wright's Directory of Nottingham puts Benjamin Dowson, of Dowson & Wright, on Clumber Road West in 1894-95 and 1898-99, Bernard Withers Dowson at Felixstowe from 1910-11, and Hubert A. Dowson, of Dowson & Wright, at Brightlands, Clumber Road East, in 1913-14 and 1915-16. The directories call Bernard 'Bernard Withers'; the return has Bernard William. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way.
source: 1891 census, 4 Clumber Road, schedule 36, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1894-95, page 48 (Leicester Special Collections id 164554); 1898-99, page 54 (id 165230); 1910-11, page 71 (id 165747).
